execution_provenance.source_loading: The newly added SQLitePermitStore logic was executed locally from the same source text committed to the branch. Full repository native checkout was unavailable because the container has no GitHub network/auth path.

source_backed_residuals.description: EffectBoundary durably consumes the permit before invoking the external effect, but terminal evidence is recorded only after the effect returns. A hard process death after the real-world effect and before _record() leaves the permit consumed while the external outcome is indeterminate and no closed receipt is guaranteed.
InMemoryPermitStore is documented as test/development only, but EffectBoundary production construction does not currently reject it.
SQLitePermitStore is intentionally only a same-host/shared-correctly-locking-filesystem reference implementation; no distributed multi-host consensus guarantee is claimed.
